## **Цена и paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Цена и paywall.**
      1 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: цена и paywall.
      Период отзывов: 6 авг. 2026 г. - 1 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают цену, подписку или paywall. Это сигнал чувствительности к монетизации.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Morgan Whatsername_, 1 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "The monthly themes went from fun things like dark academic and medieval and such to be themed after whatever movie is coming out. People have said they don’t like it, nothing changed. From my understanding, Finch has said they are not ads and they don’t make money. Regardless it’s shady and ultimately promoting media on a paid subscription. That is ridiculous. A “mental health app” shouldn’t force you to see promo that you have to pay for."
            2. _mysticalgamer666_, 6 авг. 2026 г., 4/5: "Makes cleaning and self care fun. The only problems i have with it is that, majority of items are either too expensive, or locked behind Finch Plus. For people like me who can’t afford £50 a year, it makes it somewhat inaccessible."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Реклама** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Реклама.**
      1 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: реклама.
      Период отзывов: 2 сент. 2026 г. - 2 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи замечают давление рекламы. Это сигнал о friction в монетизации и возможном преимуществе для более чистого конкурента.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _D1 Glazer or hater_, 2 сент. 2026 г., 3/5: "My sister got me to get this app and it was great. Sure it went down hill over time but the thing that pisses me off the most is the ads. The new forgotten islands is dumb. I don’t want to to pay to have an ad for a kids movie that will probably be annoying. Please stop putting out movies that haven’t come out yet as adventures. It would be better if it was movies that were popular and well known. Maybe smth Star Wars or Old marvel. It would be better and feel less like an Ad and more like something people would enjoy."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      2 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 28 мая 2026 г. - 2 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Landorous_, 2 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "This whole event is a glitchy mess. I can’t imagine how bad the movie will be. This applies to all."
            2. _anonymousical_, 2 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "trying to charge me almost $40 after i deleted the app for a plan i never chose and now i can’t even download any apps until i pay for the yearly plan for a useless and pointless app just so i can download other apps. 1 star all the way. never has had this issue before until one. if i can give a zero rating i would. useless and money hungry people and app"
            3. _plantguyhome_, 28 мая 2026 г., 1/5: "I was so excited to use this app, even considered premium, but sadly my data gets lost every time after exiting the app for a while. This means everything is gone and I just get an apology over and over. For an app that’s meant to help people (especially ones with special conditions) this felt really frustrating to me and really killed my energy yesterday, as it has happened multiple times just yesterday. If I hatch a new pet I DON’T get the promised 500 currency + the data gets lost again. 🫤 UPDATE: Now I can’t even hatch a new egg, because the App just turns grey. Whenever I try to access the old data the screen goes white for an infinite time. So I can neither log in nor create a new one. It’s just completely broken on Iphone ig."
<!--/ir-theme-->
